data.title: 新垣绫濑 · 滨海套房阳台的月光独倚
data.description: 夏夜海风习习的度假套房独立阳台，清冷如霜的月光洒满白色栏杆与浪花。绫濑身穿一袭纯白色的露肩挂脖比基尼，下身系着轻柔的半透白纱。她单手扶着栏杆，任由清凉的夜风吹拂着乌黑的长发与裙带。她微红着双颊转过身来，眼眸中盛满了月光与羞怯的笑意，散发出时尚模特兼纯情少女的绝顶魅力。
data.action: leaning against balcony railing at night, elegant pure white halter bikini and sarong, ocean moonlight illuminating bare shoulders and collarbone, gentle sea breeze blowing hair, lovely blush
data.lighting: bright silver moonlight blending with ocean waves below
data.mood: poetic moonlit elegance, pure pristine romance
data.promptProse: Standing on a seaside resort balcony beneath silver moonlight, Ayase Aragaki wears a chic white halter bikini and sheer sarong. The night ocean breeze flutters her long hair as she looks back with an enchanting blush.
data.animaCaption: Ayase standing on a moonlit resort balcony in a white bikini, looking back with a sweet blush.
